title: Storage-pump electricity mix: wind input declared OCE, supplier exists only as RER
datasets: 584039 Electricity mix, operation storage pumps, ENTSO, 2020 (CH)
observation: One wind input (0.0058202 kWh/kWh, comment `Wind Offshore / DE`) declares location OCE with supplier number 535960, the only wind-farm provider (onshore, RER). OCE exists as a geography, but the only wind dataset there is retired (`xx Electricity, at wind power plant 2MW, offshore`, 539240); current offshore wind farms exist at RER (402599, 396070, 555490). Relabelling as RER links the edge but keeps an onshore stand-in for offshore wind.
validation_scope: Re-measured on the release files on 2026-10-21.
next_action: Send to BAFU with the next batch: should the offshore share link to a current offshore wind farm at RER (402599, 396070, 555490) rather than to the onshore one?

retained.text: Filed fix: change the location from OCE to RER. The exchange comment shows offshore wind, so the relabel would keep an onshore stand-in.
